notes.title: Update Pre-Alpha 1.12 | Major Improvements, Options Menu Redesigned & More!
notes.notes:
Hello survivors, in this update we bring major improvements, such as new features, bug fixes, multiplayer advances, and more! Make sure to [url=https://discord.gg/sAdMbnVxkW]join our discord[/url] for any news. Also, right now Bromeliad is now 60% Off during the Autumn Sale until November 29th !! 🎁

First of all, we have completely redesigned the options menu, as we received a lot of feedback about it. Now the user interface will not move around with different resolutions, and all the changes are now better organized with also improving the save/ load of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/8a38d01a5e679b271c4593b26b3834e7f566c5b9.jpg[/img]

Next up, we have fixed a lot of multiplayer bugs that we thought could impact the experience. Fixing sometimes the host losing their inventory, and clients not saving their positions correctly. We have also fixed the sleeping system in co-op, now you can sleep altogether to pass the hours into the next day. We have tested and improved some of the other player`s character lagging/ jiggling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/890c5a5f93503dfc425afc14165a0fadb257d068.jpg[/img]

Then, we have been improving performance and memory management. Before when you looked at the more dense areas of the map there was a drop in the framerate. We have now managed to reduce this quite significantly, and the memory usage is not better optimized, meaning it should use less.

We have also implemented the dynamic log-based building system in a few more buildables. Now this system is also implemented in defensive walls. We also have been improving some tiny gameplay elements, such as introducing saving on cooking elements in the campfire, attack animation sometimes blocking, and flying fish. 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/a978c655659b841c202c3f8496dac6943320e236.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update Pre-Alpha 1.11 | Log-Based Building System, Tutorial & More!
notes.notes:
Hello survivors! In this update we bring incredible features that we have wanted to implement for a long time, and now they are finally implemented! Make sure to [url=https://discord.gg/sAdMbnVxkW]join our discord[/url] for any news.

First of all, we have the most important implementation, we have added a log-based placing system to our building system! This will make base construction and resource gathering much more interesting. This will be very handy in co-op with your friends, as with a team you will work faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/080cbe7f8c426a25b25fa464b733bdb752c1e624.jpg[/img]

So because of this implementation, we have added a new item, the log. You can obtain logs by chopping a tree down, and you can pick them up and carry up to 2 logs and progressively place them into your construction blueprint. Not every single build part has the log-based system implemented, as for example we didn't think that it would fit very well on chairs, campfires, etc. but we are totally open to any suggestions and feedback on this thought!

Next up we have implemented a new tutorial system. We have added this feature as we have got a lot of feedback from players that don't really know what to do at the start when they are playing for the first time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/7262a32bb23d0a05ffbc676c024e8e514303e803.jpg[/img]

With that said we have also fixed some bugs and leveled the gameplay combat experience, by modifying some of the animals and creatures' health, attack range and more. We cant wait until you start building with your friends and keep exploring the mysteries of the island.

notes.title: Multiplayer Update Is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hello guys, we are glad to inform you that the [b]multiplayer [/b]update is now [b]available![/b] We are very excited that you guys will finally be able to survive with your friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/400814313307c9ab03710e0f5853f0860679ab2d.jpg[/img]

This is the first release of Bromeliad`s multiplayer, so in the following updates, we will continue to improve it along with the single-player experience. In order to play in co-op with your friends, someone will need to host the game, creating a room. Then the others will join that room with its name. Make sure that you are all on the same region, by checking it in the right-upper corner, where you will also be able to change it into the correspondent one.

There are some bugs in the multiplayer that we are aware of and that we will be fixing in the next update, here are they:
[list]
[*] The positions of each player are not saved
[*] You can't sleep
[*] Player names above the character will often mix up
[*] In the lobby, after one game without closing the game, the room players list will often not appear
[/list]

Now there are some features that we will implement later on for the multiplayer, here are they:
[list]
[*] Head look-at syncing
[*] Equipped armor syncing
[*] Decrease player flickering
[*] Chest storage syncing
[*] Make that all players will require to be in the boss area in order to fight
[/list]

We have also improved and fixed lots of features for both the singleplayer experience and the multiplayer experience, here are some:
[list]
[*] Venom system added!
[*] Improved player blendspace locomotion!
[*] Credits added!
[*] Structure damage improved!
[*] Starving glitching sounds fixed
[*] Buffs disabled
[*] Combat music fixed
[*] Pause Menu not disabling camera mouse input fixed
[*] Tabs not being able to always open properly fixed
[*] Stone buildings are invisible fixed
[*] Bananas spawning slightly under the ground fixed
[*] Low health/stamina/cold/heat vignette panels improved
[*] Head shadow added!
[*] Pressing escape while reading clues bugging fixed
[/list]

And that is pretty much it! We will be soon making a new trailer with all the new multiplayer features, showcasing all the new cool stuff. We hope that you will have an incredible experience surviving with your friends on the island, and let's see how many bosses you can defeat! [url=https://discord.gg/sAdMbnVxkW]Join our discord server for updates.
[/url]

Gorka Games Studios,

notes.title: Update Pre-Alpha 1.9
notes.notes:
[b]Hello survivors![/b] Today we have [b]exciting things[/b] to show you. Make sure to [url=https://discord.com/invite/sAdMbnVxkW]join our discord[/url] for any news.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/48d5651fd580f2708c1f8d0d18087da1452276b1.png[/img]

We have [b]added[/b] the [b]Snow Biome! [/b]Now exploration will be more challenging, with more weather conditions and more animals/creatures, like the arctic wolf.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/7576a492bd0b0792a5cb8b75b538c5cf449692d6.png[/img]

Now you can [b]dive in the water![/b] Before you only could swim in the surface but now you can submerge into de deepness. Remember that we have added an [b]underwater oxygen system[/b], so keep an eye on that or you will drown :).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/b3067e9bea9033b981d97d5d866282e217d8fdd0.png[/img]

We have added a [b]second attack animation[/b], this improves the feeling of combat and resources harvesting.

We have [b]fixed some issues with the crafting panel[/b], as you could select an item in the smithy or mortar and pestle, and go to your inventory, and the time selected was kept, so we've fixed that. Also now the armor slots won't count as an item slot in the inventory! Also, we have fixed in the creative mode that the craft amount will not be set to 0.

Worked on some performance issues, now some things should run smoother. Also, we have taken the "Craft on smithy" for the bow and stone arrows in the tech tree. We have also added a new cursor! We have also added combat music so when you are in combat with an animal or creature.

notes.title: Update Pre-Alpha 1.8
notes.notes:
[b]Hello survivors![/b] Today we bring lots of [b]new cool features and bug fixes.[/b] Make sure to [url=https://discord.com/invite/sAdMbnVxkW]join our discord[/url] for any news.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/78feb2816a7914e7ddafafde092d110dba68a72b.png[/img]


We have added a new weather event, [b]Acid Rain![/b] Now be careful because your vision will decrease with its poisonous fog and gases. Watch out for your structures because now they will decay! But not only they will decay when there's acid rain, but also with heavy rain and thunderstorms!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/fa907fd0f6663cfd674b574175c6ce2bc2d6adda.jpg[/img]

 Because of this, we have added the option of repairing structures.


We have [b]improved our crafting system[/b], now there's a crafting queue, where every item takes a couple of seconds to craft and they can queue in order to craft. We have added an amount input box in order to be able to craft as many items as you want at once! Also, we have included a "craft max button".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/ac9170c2af9357cd15e4fcad009756390e784e1f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/43928b083af9d4d124bb99134ccfb411230255b7.jpg[/img]


We have added a few little landmarks connected to the story through some shores, so go ahead and go out to explore!


We have added a [b]lightning rod![/b] This will attract lightings, so, you can build it next to your base and for a given area, your base will be [b]protected from bolts of lightning.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/03861e54db340a296c4ce5c20c3717836aaa19a9.jpg[/img]


We have added a panel in the Main Menu where you can go to our Steam news in order to check out the latest update, which is pretty nice :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/84e2123881e97b05a0f67351e63ca275077e325b.png[/img]


[b]Now some more patch notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sheltered raycast increased.
[*] The resume button is now able to do so from the options menu.
[*] The door staying outlined fixed!
[*] Storm buff reduced!
[*] Elephants rendering horns before rest fixed.
[*] Hint time in loading screen reduced.
[*] More item options panel in inventory being stuck when closed fixed!
[*] When in an interior exterior sounds change.
[*] Sometimes crafting panel not refreshing fixed!
[*] Spawn lake drink water panel not appearing fixed!
[*] Able to drop items from inventory by pressing Q!
[*] Repair items button added!
[*] Panel for structure health added!
[*] [b]Demons[/b] now [b]should damage structures[/b], however, we [b]need your help to test[/b] this. Please [b]send feedback if they don't do damage to structures.[/b]
[/list]

And that's all the cool things for this update! Enjoy surviving!
Gorka Games Studios,

notes.title: Update Pre-Alpha 1.7
notes.notes:
[b]Hello survivors![/b] In this update, we bring lots of new features and improvements, also including some bug fixes. Make sure to [url=https://discord.com/invite/sAdMbnVxkW]join our discord[/url] for any news.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/915b521792baf3637461cd9bd1db39ddf9417574.png[/img]


Firstly we bring much more utility to the food system with [b]food buffs and more![/b] Different foods will contain different buffs, for example, raw meat will give a poisonous buff.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/2823ca46b42ccb487afd53c39101ca70f5c614ce.jpg[/img]

But there are more buffs, for example, storms will give a buff, and resting too.


We have added a [b]new fireplace[/b], which will be used to cook inside your base with a bit more comfort. A chimney can be attached to the top to make it reach the roof.


Now you can get more about each item, we have added an [b]item description[/b], and [b]more options[/b], for example, drop item, split in half, or split in the selected quantity. All this is from the inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/d4d2739e77e620fc382571cb5801f68976bd141f.jpg[/img]


Be careful [b]with thunderstorms[/b], because they now will [b]strike your base[/b], you, and any animal/creature. Remember that also a buff will start, so now you will need to be more careful with the weather.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/2f6ab050ac1b47deccae3dec68a570f3366a0cc5.jpg[/img]


We have also added a [b]second-hand slot[/b] for [b]only the torch[/b], this will be very useful at night or in dark places.


[b]More improvements/bug fixes:[/b]
Ui disable/enable button added.
Skinning knife added.
Outline tech tree color inverted fixed.
Elephant sound rate reduced.
Torch FX improved.
More settings were added to the Main Menu.
Fullscreen fixed.
Tooltip panel design improved.
More storm and Heavy Rain effects.
Pick-up notification improved.
Disabling village by distance.

notes.title: Update Pre-Alpha 1.4 is Here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/147dd56549006ecb2634189e3e476697cf8dc471.png[/img]

[b]New Update[/b] has arrived! And this one is [b]pretty big.[/b] First of all we [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1366010/announcements/detail/4774365228870404495]talked about this update before[/url] with some of the new features coming in this update, but now is out, so lets briefly talk about it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/cfd45cc3209df01ce20c984c75e34523120c3f4e.jpg[/img]

As we mentioned before we are adding [b]two new weapon/tool tier list![/b] [b]Bronze[/b] and [b]Celestial[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/14bc11f4b64b9d289b5e1b0f4d0e3f23ebdaf71c.jpg[/img]

This will be able to be forged on the furnace as iron but, for example, bronze will need [b]two new materials[/b] to be done...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/f481b181b3c89aceac40eb2b20b8f93636aeb92a.jpg[/img]

This is some [b]copper [/b]and [b]tin [/b]deposits, yes, the two new materials are those. You can find them in the pines and meadows biome.

As we mentioned in the other post, we are adding [b]achievements[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/83940a26700910fcc736bd57e83101add227b0de.jpg[/img]

Finally! But remember that we are still experimenting with the system so lets hope that everything works 😀 You will be able to see them on the achievements page on Bromeliad.

So what's next? [b]In-Game Feedback system![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/6ce40647759c8e8ad870043b20b1eafd489dee73.jpg[/img]

Here you will be able to send feedback to the [url=https://discord.com/invite/sAdMbnVxkW]discord server[/url] bot in-game! The bot will display the steam player name and message, but we couldn't handle sending screenshots yet 😧.

We have [b]added fish![/b] You can find them in lakes and there is a [b]great variety [/b]of them. You can fish them by [b]throwing a spear[/b] at them. However, they will not be in the ocean yet...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/ba7c73c889c76c074bdea482062c02fed88d5995.jpg[/img]

Like we also mentioned in the last post we [b]have added a map![/b] So you will not be lost any more in the island! You will need to guide you by the terrain shapes and forms because there is no player indicator! We have done this to enforce players to explore and learn the island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/1b8866ecd05a462699316da5d7711360b30eb28d.jpg[/img]

We have added a [b]compass[/b] you will be able to [b]craft it with tin and copper![/b] So experiment with the two new materials!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/9d15ab1ad338fe86c1b2337afc65b950282cf3b1.jpg[/img]

We have also added a [b]new cave,[/b] so go there with a torch because it will be dark, especially at night. Plus there will be [b]strong enemies[/b], so come equipped...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/642e78cd58ffe801996611ff9f066b1bf5e708df.jpg[/img]

We have also added a [b]new village[/b] that the creatures will play music at night and annoy you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/ecee01fb91bb8969b413d81213656d81a9d72a05.jpg[/img]

Now, the [b]next things[/b] are the [b]patch notes[/b], including other [b]new features[/b] and [b]bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Meds and energy plants have the sickle image on blueprints fixed.

[/list]

Next thing... [b]Steam Achievements!![/b] We will finally add achievements to Bromeliad but have in mind that we are still testing and experimenting with the system, so let's hope that all works fine ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/83940a26700910fcc736bd57e83101add227b0de.jpg[/img]

We are also working on a [b]Feedback System!![/b] Which you will be able to [b]report bugs or feedback in-game![/b] The system will send a message to the [url=https://discord.com/invite/sAdMbnVxkW][b]Discord server[/b][/url] bot and will display the Steam player name and message. We are still trying to make that it can send a screenshot of your gameplay, but it's being hard...ːsteammockingː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/6ce40647759c8e8ad870043b20b1eafd489dee73.jpg[/img]

We have [b]added fish![/b] You can fish them by throwing a spear, and they will be around lakes, still, we don't have any in the ocean...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/ba7c73c889c76c074bdea482062c02fed88d5995.jpg[/img]

Now you will not be lost around the island, or at least sometimes :) We have been [b]working on a map!![/b] So you will have to guide by the terrain forms and shapes because there's no player indicator! We have done this to make it a bit harder and try to enforce players to get to know more the island. But we will listen to the community and see what you think of that :) Best way, by the [url=https://discord.com/invite/sAdMbnVxkW][b]Discord server[/b][/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/1b8866ecd05a462699316da5d7711360b30eb28d.jpg[/img]

What's next that we have been working on?? [b]Crouching![/b] Before you couldn't crouch, because the human-bear was a bit lazy... But not anymore!!

We have also added a [b]compass![/b] This can be crafted using iron and copper.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/9d15ab1ad338fe86c1b2337afc65b950282cf3b1.jpg[/img]

We have also added another [b]new cave![/b] It seems pretty spooky, but interesting... You will need to find it by exploring the island. This cave will include strong enemies inside, so go equipped. Also bring a torch because it is really dark, especially at night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/642e78cd58ffe801996611ff9f066b1bf5e708df.jpg[/img]

We are also working on a [b]small village![/b] Where there will be enemies camping and at night they will play music with their drums and annoy you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38262723/ecee01fb91bb8969b413d81213656d81a9d72a05.jpg[/img]

We have also added [b]new music[/b] that will play at [b]random times,[/b] we would appreciate it if you would let [url=https://discord.com/invite/sAdMbnVxkW]us feedback on it.[/url]

With all that said we have also been fixing some more bugs and issues, [b]and much more![/b] remember that the update will be live on the [u][b]21st of August.[/b][/u] (For any delays we will inform it through our [url=https://discord.com/invite/sAdMbnVxkW]Discord server[/url]).

[b]Regards,[/b]

Gorka Games Studios
